title: Plan mode for two linked defects
prompt: Write the single plan-mode request you would give Claude Code for the duplicated-citation and lost-excerpt defects: symptoms, suspected files (claim-source schema, synthesis prompt, report template), constraints, definition of fixed, and the acceptance test it must run.
expected_answer: Option A. One detailed plan-mode request covering both defects, because they share the synthesis-to-report interface; separate sessions would make different assumptions, a Stop hook is a check not a strategy, and skipping planning risks rework.

rubric.check: request names both defects and the shared interface
explains why split sessions (D) and no-plan (C) are weaker
